stage: Native neutral revision 4; finish-pass corrections reviewed
reviewScope: Twenty feature regions compared against private native VR after correcting enclosures, controls, lateral motor axis, oval cover and cable routing. Full native view reviewed for continuity. Advancement approves material evaluation, not pixel-exact completion.
corrections: Three port pilots and perspective-correct stop
Seven local indicators and quarter-turn latches
Transverse electric motor with visible cooling fins
Formed white volute and oval lower mounting body
Cable drops fan toward the central vertical harness
Stepped brass body, flange fasteners and pipe unions
Broadened white motor end cap and separated its ribbed casing
Recessed bellows core with distinct metal convolutions
Olive LCD inset, selector arcs and port pilot caption plates
remaining: Original engine context occludes parts of ECO/SCU and is retained by scope.
Full 4px/6px criteria not met or certified; old adjusted landmarks no longer independent.
Gray neutral pass does not establish materials, labels or reflections acceptance.
Bellows and narrow cable/valve details require material-pass comparison; no automatic per-cell approval.
Neutral-pass denoising suppresses narrow bellows highlights; retain raw pass and verify actual runtime geometry/material response.
